operation_details.item: The workshop rejected the user's short paper in the latest decision round.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, just got the decision from the workshop. My short paper got rejected in this round. A bit deflating.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Rejections are always tough, especially after putting in the work. Any feedback you can use?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: They gave some pretty detailed comments. The core analysis on dataset shift seemed sound, but they wanted more thorough experiments. I'm planning to expand them before submitting elsewhere.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a solid plan. Expanding experiments usually strengthens the story. Are you keeping the same structure or adding new scenarios?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Probably adding a few more shift types and ablations. The code and anonymized data are already in the project repository, so I can pick up where I left off without too much hassle.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good that everything is versioned. That makes iterating way faster. Are you eyeing a particular venue for the resubmission?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'm thinking of a more general ML conference or maybe a journal. Haven't decided yet. I'll start with the experiments and see how the results look.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Let me know if you want a second pair of eyes on the experiment design or the revised write-up. Happy to help.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only the latest workshop decision about my short paper, while retaining the paper topic, revision plan, and project artifacts.
